summary: Uses Nvidia Maxine AR body tracking to output body bounding boxes, keypoints, confidence, rotations, and optional 3D body coordinates from a TOP image.
key_concepts: Uses Nvidia Maxine AR SDK models to detect one or more human bodies from a supplied TOP image or video.
The operator can output bounding boxes, per-keypoint confidence, UV keypoints, optional XYZ body coordinates, and keypoint rotations.
Body 3D changes keypoint output from UV to XYZ and depends on the camera field-of-view parameter for meaningful 3D placement.
People Tracking assigns persistent body IDs, with Max Bodies, Shadow Tracking Age, and Probation Age controlling multi-person target lifecycle.
Windows, RTX GPU, and external AR SDK model-folder requirements are planner-critical prerequisites because the models are not bundled with TouchDesigner.

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as Windows-only.
It requires an Nvidia RTX 20, 30, 40, or 50 series GPU and the Nvidia Maxine AR SDK model files.
The model files are not bundled with TouchDesigner; plans should check the model folder before relying on output.
The current SDK can track up to 8 people even if the Max Bodies parameter is higher.
Body 3D output depends on the input camera field of view, so inaccurate FOV values produce misleading XYZ coordinates.
